name: Beer
description: Guidelines for traveling with beer in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Beer is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Cans or bottles over 3.4 oz must be checked.

checkedBag.reason: Beer is allowed in checked baggage in any quantity (ABV is under 24%, so no TSA volume limit applies).

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring beer on a plane?

travelTips: Beer is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Cans or bottles over 3.4 oz must be checked.

faq.question: Is beer allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Beer is restricted in carry-on luggage. Beer is a liquid and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Cans or bottles over 3.4 oz must be checked.

faq.question: Can you pack beer in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Beer is allowed in checked bags. Beer is allowed in checked baggage in any quantity (ABV is under 24%, so no TSA volume limit applies).
